# IIT Madras Zanzibar Teaching Materials Archive - Dr. Innocent Nyalala

> Public course materials portal for Dr. Innocent Nyalala (Assistant Professor of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence, School of Engineering and Science, Indian Institute of Technology Madras Zanzibar, Bweleo, P.O. Box 2496, Zanzibar, Tanzania; Associate Research Fellow, WSAI, IIT Madras; Principal Investigator, SAAIL Lab).

## Courses Hosted (Slide PDFs, LaTeX Summaries, Cheat Sheets, Python/SQL Modules, Colab Notebooks, Automated Test Suites, Question Banks)
- **Z5007 Programming and Data Structures (MTech Core, Odd Semester 2026-27)**: https://inyalala.github.io/iitmz-teaching-site/courses/z5007/index.html
  - Complete Weeks 1-17 roadmap (`#week-01` to `#week-17`), 17 Python reference modules (`week-01/code/`..`week-17/code/`), automated `unittest` harness (`tests/test_z5007_all.py`), 17 runnable Colab notebooks (`week-01/labs/`..`week-17/labs/`), Course Project Benchmark Starter (`project/p01_project_benchmark_starter.py`, `project/P01_Project_Benchmark_Starter.ipynb`), 17 LaTeX summary PDFs, Classroom slide PDFs, Quiz 1 Practice40, Midterm Review & Worked Solutions (`resources/Z5007_Midterm_Review_Solutions.pdf`), End-Semester Mock Exam & Solutions (`resources/Z5007_EndSem_Mock_Exam_and_Solutions.pdf`), Project Guidelines & Rubric (`resources/Z5007_Project_Guidelines.pdf`, `resources/Z5007_Project_Grading_Rubric.pdf`), interactive Question Bank with Mastery Tracker & JSON Export/Print (`question-bank/index.html`, 15 worked problems), and Master Algorithms Cheat Sheet (`resources/Z5007_Algorithms_Master_Cheatsheet.pdf`).
- **Z3003 Data Mining: Scaling to Large Data (BS Core, Odd Semester 2026-27, co-taught with Dr. Mahendran V)**: https://inyalala.github.io/iitmz-teaching-site/courses/dm-scale/index.html
  - 26 verified Classroom slide PDFs (Weeks 1-9), 12 compiled LaTeX Lecture Summary PDFs (`notes/`), 9 Python reference modules + Mini-Project Starter pipeline (`code/mp01_project_starter.py`), automated `unittest` harness (`tests/test_z3003_all.py`), 10 runnable Colab notebooks (`labs/`), Lab Explorer & Part 2 Code Previews (`labs/index.html`), PySpark Lab 1 HTML, Tutorials T1-T6, W1-W4 handouts and starter notebooks, Mini-Project brief/rubric, interactive Question Bank with Mastery Tracker & JSON Export/Print (`question-bank/index.html`, 15 worked problems), Weeks 1-6 Revision & Mock Quiz (`resources/Z3003_Weeks1_6_Revision_and_Mock_Quiz.pdf`), and Formula Cheat Sheet (`resources/Z3003_Data_Mining_Formula_Cheatsheet.pdf`).
- **Z2004 Database Management Systems (BS Core, Even Semester Archive)**: https://inyalala.github.io/iitmz-teaching-site/courses/z2004/index.html
  - Lectures L01-L45 (PDFs and HTML modules), 8 SQLite3/Python labs (`code/` and `labs/`, including query join optimization and NoSQL/Graph parity), School DB SQL DDL, automated `unittest` harness (`tests/test_z2004_all.py`), 6 compiled LaTeX module summaries (`notes/`), interactive Question Bank with Mastery Tracker & JSON Export/Print (`question-bank/index.html`, 66 worked solutions), End-Semester Mock Exam & Solutions (`resources/Z2004_EndSem_Mock_Exam_and_Solutions.pdf`), SQL & Normalization Cheat Sheet (`resources/Z2004_SQL_Normalization_Cheatsheet.pdf`), and Worked Engineering Workbook (`resources/Z2004_Worked_SQL_and_Normalization_Workbook.pdf`).
- **Z5008 Big Data Lab (MTech Lab, Even Semester Archive)**: https://inyalala.github.io/iitmz-teaching-site/courses/z5008/index.html
  - 15 Lab slide decks (Docker, Delta Lake, Iceberg, Spark SQL, Airflow, Kafka, Structured Streaming, MLlib, MLflow, Prometheus/Grafana), 7 Python/Colab modules (`code/` and `labs/`, including Airflow DAG orchestration and MLflow Registry gates), automated `unittest` harness (`tests/test_z5008_all.py`), 5 LaTeX lab summaries (`notes/`), interactive Question Bank with Mastery Tracker & JSON Export/Print (`question-bank/index.html`, 68 worked solutions), Practical Capstone Mock & Rubric (`resources/Z5008_Practical_Capstone_Mock_and_Rubric.pdf`), Big Data & Lakehouse Cheat Sheet (`resources/Z5008_BigData_Lakehouse_Cheatsheet.pdf`), and Worked Spark & Streaming Workbook (`resources/Z5008_Spark_Streaming_Architecture_Workbook.pdf`).
- **Z2005 Programming and Data Structures (BS Reference Archive)**: https://inyalala.github.io/iitmz-teaching-site/courses/z2005/index.html
  - Weeks 1-17 BS reference curriculum linked to Z5007 parity Python modules, Colab notebooks, LaTeX summaries, Question Bank, and Master Cheat Sheet.
